title.zh: MECHREVO Linux Control · 机械革命本机硬件控制台与蓝牙水冷套件
title.en: MECHREVO Linux Control · Desktop Control Center, BLE Liquid Cooler & EC/Power Suite

summary.zh: 面向机械革命耀世系列的 Linux 硬件控制中心与系统调校套件：提供暗色 GTK4 控制面板、101 键单键 RGB 与自动灯光联动、外置 LCT22002/LCT21001 蓝牙水冷驱动与防干转保护、EC 功耗/风扇调校及 NVIDIA 休眠挂起修复。
summary.en: Unified Linux control suite for Mechrevo YAOSHI laptops featuring a dark anodized GTK4 desktop center, per-key RGB & profile automation, unpaired BLE LCT22002/LCT21001 external water-cooler control with flow protection, bounded EC/GPU power tuning, and NVIDIA hibernate fixes.

zh: 重构暗色 GTK4 控制台：支持 101 键单键矩阵编辑、三区灯光联动、性能模式实时监控与 LCT22002 双区灯光/曲线可视化
逆向并落地非配对 BlueZ GATT 蓝牙水冷控制栈，提供多档泵压调速、温度滞回曲线、断流急停保护及休眠自动待机
通过固定 root 助手与受 SHA-256 门禁保护的内核租约模块实现安全性能调校、只读 EC 水冷遥测与 NVIDIA DKMS 休眠修复
en: Dark anodized GTK4 studio UI covering per-key 101-key RGB matrices, lid logo glow preview, profile rules, performance tuning, and LCT22002 visualizer
Unpaired BlueZ GATT stack for external LCT22002/LCT21001 coolers with flow-stall pump shutoff, thermal hysteresis curves, and logind sleep teardown
Privilege-separated root EC helper, SHA-gated turbo kernel lease module, read-only EC/WMI telemetry bridge, and DKMS NVIDIA hibernate fix
